_help._file: Frame rate: the little fps readout (add ?fps to the address, or the Dev Kit's Perf tab) and the pass line e2e/perf.mjs judges a full tank by.
_help.targetFps: The frame rate the game aims for (a phone screen's usual 60).
_help.passMedianFps: perf.mjs passes when the middle (median) frame rate is at least this, in both goo styles.
_help.passWorstFrameMs: …and no single frame in the sample took longer than this (a visible hitch).
_help.sampleMs: How long perf.mjs measures each goo style for.
_help.meterEveryMs: How often the readout on screen updates (it shows the frames since the last update).
